provider: Baidu AI Studio 星河社区 (aistudio.baidu.com) — dataset + notebook storage

free_tier.stated: Two separate pools, which is the interesting part: (1) Notebook persistent workspace — verbatim 'Notebook每个用户提供 100G 的云端持久化存储空间作为个人工作区，访问路径为 /home/aistudio/work' (100 GB per user, persisted in real time); (2) Datasets — '单个文件大小要小于50GB，一个数据集最多可上传50G数据内容' (single file under 50 GB, one dataset holds at most 50 GB of content). So 100 GB standing + 50 GB per dataset, and datasets are a separately-created object, not a folder in the workspace.

egress.terms: Free for public datasets — downloads are anonymous HTTP from Baidu's CDN with no egress line and no per-GB charge anywhere in the docs. No metered-egress surface exists because AI Studio is not a cloud-storage product with a billing meter.

tooling: First-party pip package aistudio-sdk: `aistudio upload --repo-type {model,dataset} --include ... --max-workers N` with a User Access Token from aistudio.baidu.com/account/accessToken. Also git+LFS, and a web uploader. Python SDK + CLI both documented. No rclone backend, no S3 API.
chaining: This is the multiplier case §1 describes: 50 GB is per DATASET, and the quota field explicitly separates the 100 GB workspace from dataset storage. N datasets x 50 GB is the intended pattern (people mount several datasets into one project simultaneously — Q21 '添加数据集' shows multiple datasets attached to a single project). 20 TiB = ~410 datasets.
limits_note: 50 GB per file, 50 GB per dataset, 100 GB persistent workspace. Notebook main file (.ipynb) capped at 10 MB for preview purposes. Free GPU is 12 h/day with an 8-point/day sign-in economy, but compute is irrelevant here. Dataset uploads above 150 MB must go through the dataset path rather than direct project upload. No documented retention/expiry on datasets.

identity_cost.detail: email + any-phone, but the platform is China-facing and prior rounds recorded Chinese pans demanding +86 real-name verification and Alipay. Treat as country-phone until a registration attempt proves otherwise.

reliability_note: Datasets are mutable (versions exist — '生成新版本'). Notebook containers are recycled when idle and have a forced maximum lifetime, but /home/aistudio/work is described as real-time persistent, so the workspace is the durable part. Heavily China-network-oriented; download speeds from outside CN are untested here.

evidence.proved: Q1 '单个文件大小要小于50GB，一个数据集最多可上传50G数据内容'
read live: five upload methods; `aistudio upload -h` showing --repo-type {model,dataset} and --max-workers; token at /account/accessToken
